difficulty_reason: The usual infinite-presentation normal form may be much longer than the word norm. The author constructs finite-generator normal forms with at most one rotation letter and linear length control, then reduces all two- and three-rotation triangular loops through the interval stabilizer and explicit conjugation relations with quadratic area. This new efficient dynamical normal-form and filling construction is beyond ordinary qualifying presentation manipulations; Guba’s theorem for F is an explicit prerequisite.
